Tweaks: YTLite, DontEatMyContent, MaxTubeExtras, YouTubeDislikesReturn, VolumeBoostYT, YouGroupSettings, YouChooseQuality, YouGetCaption, YouLoop, YouMute, YouPiP, YouShare +8

This is a mod for YouTube on iOS/iPadOS, featuring over hundred customizable options but with the latest version of YTPlus/YTLite freed and with more tweaks than the original YouTube Plus.
This includes the following tweaks:
YouPiP, YTUHD, Return YouTube Dislikes, YouQuality, DontEatMyContent, YTABConfig, YTweaks (only on YTPlusM versions), Gonerino (only on YTPlusM versions), YouSpeed (only on YTPlusM versions), YTLowContrastMode (only on YTPlusM versions), VolumeBoostYT (only on YTPlusM versions), YouGetCaption (only on YTPlusM versions), YTPlaybackFix by Mark02-2012, YouChooseQuality, YouShare, YouLoop, YouMute, and YTLowContrastMode which is configurable. You can see more information about this mod at: https://github.com/Mark02-2012/MaxTube
